nodes.label: The Folder Is the Database
nodes.rationale: The SQLite index is a cache that can be deleted and rebuilt; no state lives only in the app.

nodes.label: The Folder Is the Source of Truth; .dossier Is Disposable
nodes.norm_label: the folder is the source of truth; .dossier is disposable

nodes.label: Read Is Free, Write Is Explicit
nodes.community_name: Read Is Free, Write Is Explicit
nodes.norm_label: read is free, write is explicit
nodes.rationale: No autosave-over-source, no silent reformatting, no background rewrites.

nodes.label: Conditional Writes with mtime_ns + sha256 Stamp
nodes.community_name: Read Is Free, Write Is Explicit
nodes.norm_label: conditional writes with mtime_ns + sha256 stamp
nodes.rationale: Another agent session writes into the proving-ground folder, so a stale stamp must be refused with 409 rather than silently overwriting.

nodes.label: negotiation-verbatim Gate
nodes.rationale: An unverifiable number is dropped, not caveated, because a caveat does not survive a real conversation.

nodes.label: Lesson 9: An Unverifiable Number Must Be Dropped, Not Caveated
nodes.norm_label: lesson 9: an unverifiable number must be dropped, not caveated
nodes.rationale: A caveat does not survive contact with a real conversation.

nodes.label: partial-is-not-exhaustive Gate
nodes.rationale: A blocked or partial capture is never reported as complete coverage.

nodes.label: Lesson 6: Bound a Crawl by the Responses You Get
nodes.norm_label: lesson 6: bound a crawl by the responses you get
nodes.rationale: Stale pagination links survive a shrunken result set, and the response shape was assumed instead of checked.

nodes.label: Lesson 4: Verify Index Freshness Numerically
nodes.rationale: The residual watcher question is still open, so the watcher must not be described as reliable.

nodes.label: Bounded /api/events Streaming Route
nodes.community_name: Lesson 15: An Unbounded Stream Is a Trap for Every Other Client
nodes.rationale: An unbounded stream hangs every client that does not know about it, including a script enumerating the API.

nodes.label: Lesson 15: An Unbounded Stream Is a Trap for Every Other Client
nodes.community_name: Lesson 15: An Unbounded Stream Is a Trap for Every Other Client
nodes.norm_label: lesson 15: an unbounded stream is a trap for every other client
nodes.rationale: The route was fine for the one UI that knew about it and fatal for anything else.

nodes.label: Modes the Engine Completes Without a Model
nodes.community_name: Modes the Engine Completes Without a Model

nodes.label: graft callers: Exact Edges and Blast Radius
nodes.community_name: graft callers: Exact Edges and Blast Radius
nodes.norm_label: graft callers: exact edges and blast radius
nodes.rationale: Precomputed call edges walk transitively, surfacing sibling and downstream files a single-file edit would miss.

nodes.label: Querying a Node Beats Reading Source
nodes.community_name: Querying a Node Beats Reading Source
nodes.norm_label: querying a node beats reading source
nodes.rationale: A node query costs a few hundred tokens; reading the source to rebuild that understanding costs thousands and misses edges.

nodes.label: graft grep: Exhaustive Find
nodes.rationale: Ranked ask results are top-N and will miss instances; grep will not.

nodes.label: Pick the One Tool That Fits
nodes.community_name: Pick the One Tool That Fits
nodes.norm_label: pick the one tool that fits
nodes.rationale: Most tasks need one call; chaining tools hoping for more wastes budget.

nodes.label: Per-Folder bundles.json Rules
nodes.rationale: Stem rules live in data so a different folder gets different rules without touching code.

nodes.label: OKLCH Cool-Neutral Token Set
nodes.rationale: Only two chromatic tokens; --stale is the only warm thing on screen so a stale render is visible across the room.

nodes.label: The Interface Is a Light Table
nodes.community_name: The Interface Is a Light Table
nodes.norm_label: the interface is a light table
nodes.rationale: The folder already encodes generate to render to look at it, so the documents are the only things with colour.

nodes.label: base-document Gate
nodes.rationale: There is no template fallback; without a real user .docx, BaseDocumentMissing is raised.

nodes.label: layout-clone Gate
nodes.rationale: Only the objective, section order, skills order and explicitly approved rewrites may differ from the base.

nodes.label: no-auto-submit Gate
nodes.rationale: Field approval and submit approval are separate, human-owned steps.

nodes.label: posting-is-data Gate
nodes.rationale: Instruction-shaped content inside a posting is reported, never followed.

nodes.label: token-never-leaks Gate
nodes.rationale: The per-run bearer token never appears in a handoff, log, report or artifact.

nodes.label: Consolidation Deliverable Marked PARTIAL
nodes.rationale: The wrapper is intact and verified, but the full per-session acceptance-criteria register was not produced.

nodes.label: 35.8 GB Disk Budget
nodes.rationale: No Electron, no Monaco, no Chromium download; node_modules stays under 400 MB and is deletable after build.

nodes.label: Root Confinement
nodes.rationale: Every client path is resolved under root; no absolute path is accepted from the client, ever.

nodes.label: Lesson 1: Job Records Must Carry Unique Ids
nodes.community_name: Lesson 1: Job Records Must Carry Unique Ids
nodes.norm_label: lesson 1: job records must carry unique ids
nodes.rationale: Filtering the jobs pane kept the wrong rows because 1789 records shared only 1669 distinct ids.

nodes.label: Lesson 2: A Fit Score Must Not Cross a Shared Listing URL
nodes.community_name: Lesson 2: A Fit Score Must Not Cross a Shared Listing URL
nodes.norm_label: lesson 2: a fit score must not cross a shared listing url
nodes.rationale: A URL is a location, not an identity.

nodes.label: Lesson 5: A Coverage Snapshot Must Be Resolved, Not Hard-Coded
nodes.community_name: Lesson 5: A Coverage Snapshot Must Be Resolved, Not Hard-Coded
nodes.norm_label: lesson 5: a coverage snapshot must be resolved, not hard-coded
nodes.rationale: A hard-coded coverage filename made the ledger, freshness and fit-coverage checks report stale data.

nodes.label: Lesson 11: A Module Function Named all Shadows the Builtin
nodes.community_name: Lesson 11: A Module Function Named all Shadows the Builtin
nodes.norm_label: lesson 11: a module function named all shadows the builtin
nodes.rationale: verify.all shadowed the builtin inside its own module, so the summary line called the entry point instead.

nodes.label: Lesson 16: AppConfig.create Describes a Layout, It Does Not Create It
nodes.community_name: Lesson 16: AppConfig.create Describes a Layout, It Does Not Create It
nodes.norm_label: lesson 16: appconfig.create describes a layout, it does not create it
nodes.rationale: The bug only lived on the command line, which is exactly where a person meets it first.

nodes.label: Ask the Engine, Do Not Re-Derive It
nodes.norm_label: ask the engine, do not re-derive it
nodes.rationale: Re-deriving workspace state from prose invites drift; the engine is the authority for state and the next unit of work.

nodes.label: graft Repo Context Graph
nodes.rationale: Rebuilding understanding by reading source costs thousands of tokens and misses the edges.

nodes.label: Open Items Carried to the Worklist
nodes.norm_label: open items carried to the worklist
nodes.rationale: Open items are stated explicitly rather than hidden.

nodes.label: Verification Receipts (quoted, not narrated)
nodes.rationale: 143 passed in 13.03s; adapters --check true on the repo and exit 1 on an empty root; manifest reproduces 21 modes / 27 artifacts / 14 gates.

nodes.label: What Survived of the Prior Sessions: the Lessons
nodes.norm_label: what survived of the prior sessions: the lessons
nodes.rationale: The workspace itself was read, not copied; only the lessons became code rules and tests.

nodes.label: The resume-tailoring Skill
nodes.rationale: An 88 KB SKILL.md plus a 48 KB modes reference and five standalone helper scripts.

nodes.label: Only WORKLIST.md Is a Live Checklist
nodes.norm_label: only worklist.md is a live checklist

nodes.label: manifest.py Is the Single Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: manifest.py is the single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Generated docs are not edited by hand because two copies of one rule drift.

nodes.label: Align the resume-tailoring Skill with the Executable Contract
nodes.norm_label: align the resume-tailoring skill with the executable contract

nodes.label: Dossier Design Brief
nodes.rationale: One line job of the app: open any file in a folder, understand it in context, change it, move it forward.

nodes.label: Contract (generated from the manifest)
nodes.rationale: Modes and gates are generated, never hand-edited, so the contract cannot drift from the code.

nodes.label: Lessons
nodes.rationale: Every entry is something that actually failed on real data; deleting the code means deleting the entry.

nodes.label: Sources
nodes.rationale: A future reader must be able to tell an intentional rule from an inherited accident.

nodes.label: PLAN.md Historical Stub
nodes.rationale: The original checklist describes the initial app, not current work, so it is preserved rather than deleted.

nodes.label: Every Claim of Done Needs a Receipt
nodes.norm_label: every claim of done needs a receipt
nodes.rationale: The exact command and its output line, or it is not done.

nodes.label: Lesson 10: A Prompt File Must Not Embed Live State
nodes.norm_label: lesson 10: a prompt file must not embed live state
nodes.rationale: A committed document containing a number the repository changes is wrong by construction and can never verify.

nodes.label: Lesson 12: Reading Is Not Running
nodes.rationale: A generator that looks fine on disk crashed on run after a sibling module was renamed.

nodes.label: Lesson 14: A Gate Naming Code That Does Not Exist Is Decoration
nodes.norm_label: lesson 14: a gate naming code that does not exist is decoration
nodes.rationale: A reader following the contract landed nowhere because engine and enforced_by named unwritten symbols.

nodes.label: Managed Blocks Preserve Surrounding Content
nodes.rationale: The generators can run safely over files they did not create.

nodes.norm_label: lesson 19: the section a model is told to run first should not be below the fold
nodes.rationale: A duplicated heading hides a section silently; nobody re-reads a rendered packet to notice.
